results.title: Experiences of Ethical Review: Perspectives of Swedish ...
results.content: Some of the participants said that a much too strong focus on ethical review and how to fill in the ethics application takes time away from discussion on other important topics in research ethics – not least when it comes to teaching research ethics to PhD students. Another participant – also coming from the humanities – stressed that the requirement of ethical review had led to a much broader ethical discussion within their field of research. Some participants provided examples of research that might be difficult to perform because of ethical review. As already noted, the participants said that the ethical review system is overly restrictive as it requires ethical approval for research on publicly available sensitive personal data. In this article, we have presented findings from 7 semi-structured group interviews with researchers in social sciences and the humanities concerning their experiences and perceptions of ethical review in Sweden.
